sentences.englishText: Highway vehicles transport more passengers and cargo than trains in Turkey today.
sentences.turkishText: Türkiye'de bugün kara yolu araçları trenlerden daha fazla yolcu ve kargo taşımaktadır.

sentences.englishText: Trains are cheaper because they can carry more cargo and use coal instead of petrol.
sentences.turkishText: Trenler daha fazla kargo taşıyabildikleri ve petrol yerine kömür kullandıkları için daha ucuzdur.

sentences.englishText: Transporting goods by train is more economical and wagons last longer than trucks.
sentences.turkishText: Malları trenle taşımak daha ekonomiktir ve vagonlar kamyonlardan daha uzun ömürlüdür.

enrichment.summary: Highway vehicles transport more passengers and cargo than trains in Turkey today. Trains are cheaper because they can carry more cargo and use coal instead of petrol.
